purpose: Teach: 貰い/こんど/赤ん坊/終り/ゴメン/歌わ/ここら/行進

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが貰い物のお酒、お喜びだったぞ
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, Dad was always so pleased when he got a gift of sake.
lines.style: Soft, distant gaze into memory. Opening word gentle and measured. Long pause between thoughts. Voice thin with age, but steady. Slight smile in the tone.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、こんど旅行に行こうとおっしゃってたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and Grandpa said he wanted to go on a trip next time, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, present. Gentle agreement that tilts toward a question. Voice brightens slightly, testing if he remembers. Affirming without pushing. A small lift at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが赤ん坊だったお祖父ちゃんを抱いていたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, Dad held Grandpa when he was just a baby.
lines.style: Voice thins further into reverence. Opens with breath, not force. Sits with the image. Slower pace. Weight of generations in the pause between clauses.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、夏の終りに浴衣を着られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And Grandpa wore his yukata at the end of summer, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Gentle, almost singing the memory. Warm affection in the pacing. She's remembering his shape in the fabric. Voice carries fondness without sentimentality. Rising slightly on the question.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが「ゴメン」と心からおっしゃったぞ
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, Dad said 'I'm sorry' and he really meant it.
lines.style: Voice catches slightly on the apology. Opens with tenderness, not sadness. The weight of sincerity. Quiet conviction. Trails off as if the apology still resonates.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お正月によく童謡を歌わせてくださったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And Grandpa, he used to have you sing children's songs at New Year, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Voice lifts with the memory of music. Playful warmth beneath the tenderness. She's seeing him singing, hearing his voice. Gentle tease in the rhythm. Lilting question at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、ここらの田んぼで遊んだぞ
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, he used to play in the rice fields around here.
lines.style: Opens with a small, quiet laugh in the voice. Eyes distant. Pace slows for the simple image. Breathes the place into being. Quiet contentment, not excitement. Trails into the memory itself.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、街の行進をご覧になったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And Grandpa, you watched the parade through town, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm and close. Voice touches his arm without moving. She's seeing him in the crowd, young. Gentle certainty. A soft, lingering affection in the close of her phrase.
